svg.title: E-commerce System Entity Relationship Diagram
svg.desc: ERD based on the Prisma schema, showing model fields, primary and foreign keys, and relationship cardinalities.
svg.text: Prisma schema - solid model definitions - PK primary key - FK foreign key - UK unique
Cardinality is shown from the first model to the second; nullable Order.userId permits guest orders.
ID-like fields without declared foreign keys include Order.cartId, OrderItem.variantId, promotionCode fields, and audit actor/entity IDs. See ecommerce-erd.md for details.
